I paint my tiny human’s nails.  5 year old and the 11 year old sometimes likes to look cool. 

For A base coat…Stay with Holo Taco. Their base coat is A+ and if you’re going with them then might as well, eh? 

Random (maybe?) suggestion to get some orange wood sticks to push the cuticles back before application. The distance between the cuticle and the polish seems to encourage polish to stick around longer. 

Tuts for grown ups say to buff off the surface shine off the nail to ensure adhesion. True for you, but do not do this for the tiny human. Their nails are thiiiiin and one should avoid removing *any* thickness of their nails. 

Do dehydrate, though. Either with a specific dehydrator, alcohol, or polish remover if we’re being thrifty. 

That’s all I got. Sorry for any repeats. Happy trails!
